trained_at: unknown — predates model versioning; artifact mtime is the only record
target_definition: PREDETERMINED BANDS, NOT A HISTORICAL OUTCOME. Each training sample's class was assigned by construction from the band a human typed it into: average_grade >= 85 -> low, 75-84.9 -> moderate, below 75 -> high. The classifier was then fitted to those labels, so it reproduces the bands it was handed rather than a signal discovered in data.
dataset_label: 90 hand-typed average_grade literals, 30 per class — see analytics/legacy/prototype_model.py::_synthetic_training_set

split_methodology.method: none — 5-fold cross-validation on the synthetic training set only; no held-out data, no cohort split, no real learners

missing_value_strategy: not_applicable — the single feature is always present
missing_value_policy: Not applicable: this model reads one always-present feature.

baseline_comparison.note: No baseline comparison was ever run. A single-threshold rule on average_grade would score identically on this data, which is the point: the model reproduces a rule rather than adding predictive value over it.

runtime_versions.note: Not recorded at fit time. classify.py compares the unpickling runtime against the versions below at load and warns on a mismatch.

limitations: Trained on 90 hand-typed synthetic values; no real learner appears in its training data.
Single feature (average_grade). Laravel computes the full canonical feature set; this model reads one column of it.
Labels were predetermined by grade band, so the model largely reproduces those bands rather than a learned signal.
Its reported cross-validation accuracy is expected arithmetic for a perfectly separable one-feature problem and is NOT real-world accuracy.

Because it only sees an average, it cannot see a failing subject hidden behind a high average — the rule-based failing-subject override in Adviser\ReportController exists precisely to cover that blind spot.
notes: LEGACY SYNTHETIC PROTOTYPE, retained deliberately so the deployed DSS keeps working while the real training pipeline waits for an authorized historical dataset. This descriptor is hand-written metadata FOR an artifact that predates the registry; it is not the output of a training run. Replace by training a real candidate (analytics/train_model.py) and promoting it (analytics/model_registry.py promote).
